```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os

# Create a poster for the Jazz Night event
def create_jazz_poster():
    # Poster dimensions (8.5x11 inches at 300 DPI = 2550x3300 pixels)
    width, height = 2550, 3300
    bg_color = (20, 20, 30)  # Dark navy background
    
    # Create image
    img = Image.new('RGB', (width, height), bg_color)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    
    # Define colors
    gold = (255, 215, 0)
    cream = (255, 240, 220)
    dark_gray = (80, 80, 90)
    jazz_red = (180, 40, 40)
    
    # Draw background decorative elements (simple circles/lines)
    # Coffee bean shapes (circles)
    draw.ellipse([500, 800, 700, 1000], fill=(50, 30, 20), outline=(80, 50, 20), width=10)
    draw.ellipse([1800, 2000, 2000, 2200], fill=(50, 30, 20), outline=(80, 50, 20), width=10)
    draw.ellipse([200, 2500, 400, 2700], fill=(50, 30, 20), outline=(80, 50, 20), width=10)
    
    # Title - Coffee & Jazz Evening
    try:
        # Try to use a larger font
        title_font = ImageFont.truetype("/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf", 400)
    except:
        title_font = ImageFont.load_default()
    
    # Draw title (gradient effect with multiple rectangles)
    title_text = "Coffee & Jazz Evening"
    title_x = (width - len(title_text) * 60) // 2
    title_y = 300
    
    # Create shadow
    draw.rectangle([title_x + 5, title_y + 5, title_x + len(title_text) * 60, title_y + 250], 
                   fill=(0, 0, 0, 100))
    
    # Draw title text with gold color
    draw.text((title_x, title_y), title_text, fill=gold, font=title_font)
    
    # Draw decorative line
    draw.line([(width//2 - 300, 580), (width//2 + 300, 580)], fill=gold, width=5)
    
    # Date and Time
    date_text = "Every Thursday 7-10 PM"
    date_x = (width - len(date_text) * 50) // 2
    date_y = 650
    
    draw.rectangle([date_x, date_y, date_x + len(date_text) * 50, date_y + 100], 
                   fill=(0, 0, 0, 50))
    draw.text((date_x + 10, date_y + 20), date_text, fill=cream, font=title_font)
    
    # Location
    location_text = "The Grind Coffee House"
    location_x = (width - len(location_text) * 50) // 2
    location_y = 800
    
    draw.rectangle([location_x, location_y, location_x + len(location_text) * 50, location_y + 100], 
                   fill=(0, 0, 0, 50))
    draw.text((location_x + 10, location_y + 20), location_text, fill=cream, font=title_font)
    
    # Features
    features = ["Live music", "Artisan coffee", "Cozy atmosphere"]
    feature_y = 1050
    feature_x = width // 2 - 500
    
    for i, feature in enumerate(features):
        draw.rectangle([feature_x, feature_y, feature_x + 1000, feature_y + 70], fill=(0, 0, 0, 50))
        draw.text((feature_x + 20, feature_y + 20), feature, fill=dark_gray, font=title_font)
        feature_y += 90
    
    # Footer with decorative elements
    draw.line([(0, height - 100), (width, height - 100)], fill=gold, width=3)
    
    # Musical note decoration
    try:
        note_font = ImageFont.truetype("/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf", 300)
    except:
        note_font = ImageFont.load_default()
    
    # Draw some musical note patterns (simple circles as notes)
    for i in range(10):
        note_x = 100 + i * 250
        note_y = height - 150
        draw.ellipse([note_x, note_y - 50, note_x + 100, note_y + 50], fill=gold, outline=cream, width=3)
    
    # Event marker
    marker_text = "JAZZ_NIGHT_EVENT_MARKER_12345"
    marker_x = (width - len(marker_text) * 30) // 2
    marker_y = height - 20
    
    draw.rectangle([marker_x, marker_y, marker_x + len(marker_text) * 30, marker_y + 80], 
                   fill=(20, 20, 30), outline=gold, width=2)
    draw.text((marker_x, marker_y + 15), marker_text, fill=jazz_red, font=note_font)
    
    # Save the poster
    output_path = "/workspace/jazz_night_poster.png"
    img.save(output_path, "PNG")
    print(f"Poster created successfully: {output_path}")
    print(f"Poster dimensions: {width}x{height} pixels")
    
    return output_path

if __name__ == "__main__":
    create_jazz_poster()
```
